metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2003 · The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2001 · The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
metas.description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2002 · The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
metas.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2003 · Spirited Away
metas.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2003 · Anbe Sivam
metas.description: Two men, one young and arrogant, the other damaged - physically but not spiritually - by life, are thrown together by circumstances, and find that they are in some ways bound together by fate.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2000 · Gladiator
metas.description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2008 · WALL·E
metas.description: A robot who is responsible for cleaning a waste-covered Earth meets another robot and falls in love with her. Together, they set out on a journey that will alter the fate of mankind.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2009 · Up
metas.description: 78-year-old Carl Fredricksen travels to South America in his house equipped with balloons, inadvertently taking a young stowaway.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2003 · Finding Nemo
metas.description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2004 · Howl's Moving Castle
metas.description: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2003 · Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2001 · Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: In order to power the city, monsters have to scare children so that they scream. However, the children are toxic to the monsters, and after a child gets through, two monsters realize things may not be what they think.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2007 · Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2004 · The Incredibles
metas.description: While trying to lead a quiet suburban life, a family of undercover superheroes are forced into action to save the world.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2004 · Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
metas.description: Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione return to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for their third year of study, where they delve into the mystery surrounding an escaped prisoner who poses a dangerous threat to the young wizard.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2006 · Casino Royale
metas.description: After earning a licence to kill, secret agent James Bond sets out on his first mission as 007. Bond must defeat a private banker funding terrorists in a high-stakes game of poker at Casino Royale, in Montenegro.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2007 · Into the Wild
metas.description: After graduating from Emory University, top student and athlete Christopher McCandless abandons his possessions, gives his entire $24,000 savings account to charity and hitchhikes to Alaska to live in the wilderness.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2006 · Blood Diamond
metas.description: A fisherman, a smuggler, and a syndicate of businessmen match wits over the possession of a priceless diamond.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2004 · G.O.R.A.
metas.description: A slick young Turk kidnapped by extraterrestrials shows his great « humanitarian spirit » by outwitting the evil commander-in-chief of the planet of G.O.R.A.
